svg.title: Measure crude-reaction phosphorus NMR
svg.desc: Conceptual operation diagram; only source-stated equipment and conditions apply.
svg.text: Sample the 0.75-equivalent reaction at 30 s, 10 min, 1 h and 2 h.
Measure in benzene-d6 on the 500 MHz instrument at 298 K. The
quoted 500 MHz describes the instrument; no 31P resonance
frequency is inferred. NMR aliquot volumes are unreported.
Conceptual operation diagram; only source-stated equipment and conditions apply.
